title: dev.qory.runtime.started
description: The runtime opened its session. In a run with a run key, Forager writes placeholders in cwd alone; every other member is as the runtime wrote it.

session.description: The number of the session whose runtime wrote the record, from 1: the session of its dev.qory.session.started.

source.description: How the session started, in the runtime's words: startup, resume.

cwd.description: The runtime's working directory, as the runtime wrote it. In a run with a run key, the working directory is /workspace in it, and the run directory, the harness home and the inputs directory are <run>, <home> and <inputs>, at whole path components, as in args of dev.qory.session.started.

agent_id.description: The subagent this happened in, when it did not happen in the main conversation.

agent_type.description: The subagent's type, or the agent the session was started as.
